recēdō

recēdō, recēdere, recessī, recessum

verb, third conjugation

go back, fall back, withdraw

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. BG 5.43: centuriōnēs ex eō quō stābant locō recessērunt (Lewis & Short); Cic. Off. 3.19: ab officiō recēdere (Lewis & Short)
